overloadMerges.note: leftTitle, centerTitle, rightTitle, height, picture and pictAlignment are all documented with the '←' arrow (values returned/filled by the command), not '→'; auto-parse defaulted all of them to direction 'in'. Also records the documented selector and pictAlignment constants as sentinelValues.

params.name: selector
params.description: Which of the header/footer to retrieve

params.name: leftTitle
params.description: Text displayed on the left side

params.name: rightTitle
params.description: Text displayed on the right side

params.name: height
params.description: Header or footer height, expressed in the report's selected unit

params.name: picture
params.description: Picture displayed in the header or footer

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves the contents (left/center/right title text, height, and optional picture with alignment) of either the report header or footer of area, as selected by selector.
